mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper directly supports varied LPS binding/neutralization capacity for the tested mammalian and helminth peptides in a Chromo-LAL assay, with Sm16-p73 and SmHDM-1p146 showing no detectable LPS interaction while FhHDM-1p2 and SmHDM-2p58 show weaker binding than mammalian controls.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: FhHDM-1p2, Sm16-p73, SmHDM-1p146, SmHDM-2p58, and mammalian control cathelicidins
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports LPS-binding context, not direct bacterial killing by helminth peptides.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports absence of direct antimicrobial and antiprotozoan activity for helminth HDMs under the tested MIC and Cryptosporidium viability conditions, while mammalian controls remain active in those assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: helminth-derived HDMs compared with LL-37, CRAMP, SMAP-29, and BMAP-28 controls
mechanism_claims.limitations: MIC and viability assays establish phenotype-level activity/nonactivity but not a molecular killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TO-PRO uptake and LDH release assays support that helminth HDMs do not form macrophage membrane pores or induce macrophage cytotoxicity at tested concentrations, whereas mammalian controls show cytolytic effects at higher concentrations.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: helminth-derived HDMs and mammalian cathelicidin controls in RAW 264.7 macrophages
mechanism_claims.limitations: These are cytotoxicity/membrane-integrity assays and are not promoted to a bacterial membrane mechanism for helminth peptides.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Macrophage TNF ELISA and B-cell immunoglobulin ELISA assays support immunomodulatory activity of helminth HDMs: they suppress LPS/IFNγ-induced TNF and alter IgG1/IgG2a secretion under the tested stimulation conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: helminth-derived HDMs and mammalian controls in murine macrophages and B cells
direct_assay_types: bone marrow-derived macrophage TNF ELISA after LPS/IFNγ stimulation
murine splenic B-cell IgG1/IgG2a ELISA after LPS/cytokine stimulation
mechanism_claims.limitations: The claim is limited to in vitro immune-cell readouts; exact plotted concentrations/effect sizes are not reconstructed beyond qualitative source conclusions.
